name: Split Sheet Studio — Direct signup onboarding

parameters.content:
## Direct signup journey

Welcome → first action → vault → plugin skins → approved collaborators → next session.
Planned days: 0, 2, 4, 7, 10, 14. The app checks current account activity, plan and consent before delivery.

1. Deploy the app changes. Set ONBOARDING_AUTOMATION_TOKEN and EMAIL_JOURNEYS_ENABLED.
2. In the HTTP node, select Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer <the same token>.
3. Execute with dryRun=true; this never sends email.
4. Change dryRun to false, test with your own opted-in account, and publish.

The app sends through its existing SES/SMTP service. This workflow receives counts only. See docs/email-automation.md for recovery and suppression behavior.
